The '''Kidiet Olgo system''' was located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kidiet Olgo]], which was a [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] and a hotbed of [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]].
